name: Bridged-Fan-In-1K-5-1K-1K
comments: Bridge test: 1k publishers on one broker, 5 shared subscribers on another.
What this checks: the subscribers subscribe to the shared topic on the far side, the
publishers publish to N topics on the near side, the bridge carries those topics across,
and the group receives N messages in total - one delivery per message, distributed across
the five subscribers, rather than N to each of them.
